```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def grid(svg, start_x, start_y, size, cols=5, rows=5, css_class="grid"):
    for col in range(cols + 1):
        x = start_x + col * size
        svg.append(f'  <line x1="{x}" y1="{start_y}" x2="{x}" y2="{start_y + rows * size}" class="{css_class}"/>')
    for row in range(rows + 1):
        y = start_y + row * size
        svg.append(f'  <line x1="{start_x}" y1="{y}" x2="{start_x + cols * size}" y2="{y}" class="{css_class}"/>')


width, height = 1600, 760
cell = 70
active = {(1, 1), (2, 1), (3, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 2), (3, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3), (3, 3), (2, 4)}
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Conversió d’un polígon vectorial a una graella i retorn a vector</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">El polígon original se superposa a una graella; la rasterització activa les cel·les segons la posició dels centres i la vectorització posterior crea un contorn esglaonat que segueix les vores de les cel·les.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c5d0d5; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .heading { fill: #21313c; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #4f626b; font-size: 28px; }',
    '      .grid { stroke: #aebbc1; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .grid-faint { stroke: #dbe2e5; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; }',
    '      .source { fill: #7cb3c8; fill-opacity: .35; stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 6; }',
    '      .active { fill: #e3a574; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .inactive { fill: #eef3f5; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .centre { fill: #334750; }',
    '      .vectorized { fill: #80af8d; fill-opacity: .45; stroke: #2d7f5c; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linejoin: miter; }',
    '      .arrow { stroke: #596b74; stroke-width: 5; fill: none; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); }',
    '      .arrow-label { fill: #596b74; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="12" refX="10" refY="5" orient="auto">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,10 L11,5 z" fill="#596b74"/>',
    '    </marker>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <rect width="1600" height="760" fill="#f7f9fa"/>',
]

for x in (20, 545, 1070):
    svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="25" width="510" height="710" class="panel"/>')

# Original vector geometry over the reference grid.
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="275" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Geometria vectorial</text>',
    '  <path d="M 105,330 C 125,225 205,175 315,190 C 430,205 470,295 435,395 C 410,465 355,525 275,535 C 200,545 115,470 105,330 Z" class="source"/>',
])
grid(svg, 85, 135, cell, css_class="grid-faint")
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="275" y="585" text-anchor="middle" class="note">coordenades i límit continu</text>',
    '  <text x="275" y="620" text-anchor="middle" class="note">segons la geometria d’entrada</text>',
    '  <line x1="492" y1="345" x2="568" y2="345" class="arrow"/>',
    '  <text x="530" y="320" text-anchor="middle" class="arrow-label">rasteritza</text>',
])

# Rasterized result using cell centres.
svg.append('  <text x="800" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Cel·les activades</text>')
for row in range(5):
    for col in range(5):
        x = 610 + col * cell
        y = 135 + row * cell
        css_class = "active" if (col, row) in active else "inactive"
        svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="{cell}" height="{cell}" class="{css_class}"/>')
        svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x + cell / 2}" cy="{y + cell / 2}" r="5" class="centre"/>')
grid(svg, 610, 135, cell)
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="800" y="585" text-anchor="middle" class="note">atribut, mida, origen i regla</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="620" text-anchor="middle" class="note">decideixen el valor de cada cel·la</text>',
    '  <line x1="1017" y1="345" x2="1093" y2="345" class="arrow"/>',
    '  <text x="1055" y="320" text-anchor="middle" class="arrow-label">vectoritza</text>',
])

# Vectorized result follows cell edges.
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1325" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">Contorn vectoritzat</text>',
    '  <path d="M 1210,205 L 1420,205 L 1420,415 L 1350,415 L 1350,485 L 1280,485 L 1280,415 L 1210,415 L 1210,345 L 1140,345 L 1140,275 L 1210,275 Z" class="vectorized"/>',
])
grid(svg, 1140, 135, cell, css_class="grid-faint")
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1325" y="585" text-anchor="middle" class="note">vores esglaonades i possibles</text>',
    '  <text x="1325" y="620" text-anchor="middle" class="note">illes segons la classificació</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="690" text-anchor="middle" class="note">La conversió canvia la representació; el recorregut invers no recupera el límit original.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/07-model-analisi-raster/vector-raster-conversion.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
